general.q: How many hearts does an octopus have?
general.why: An octopus has three hearts: two pump blood to the gills, while the larger one pumps blood to the body.

general.q: Which British passenger liner was sunk by a German U-boat off the southern coast of Ireland in May 1915?
general.why: The sinking of the Lusitania claimed 1,198 lives and hardened American opinion against Germany.

general.q: Which Brazilian spirit distilled from fermented sugarcane juice forms the base of a classic Caipirinha?
general.why: Cachaça is distilled from fresh sugarcane juice, whereas standard rum is typically made from molasses.

general.q: Which metal has the highest melting point of any element on the periodic table?
general.why: Tungsten melts at 3,422 °C, making it historically indispensable for incandescent light bulb filaments.

general.q: Excluding the Sun, which star is closest to Earth?
general.why: Proxima Centauri is a faint red dwarf located roughly 4.24 light-years away in the constellation Centaurus.

pop.q: In the BBC comedy series The League of Gentlemen, what is the name of the shop run by Edward and Tubbs?
pop.why: Edward and Tubbs were fiercely protective of their local shop for local people in Royston Vasey.

pop.q: In the 1994 action film Speed, below what speed in miles per hour will the bomb on the bus detonate?
pop.why: Keanu Reeves and Sandra Bullock had to keep the bus above 50 mph to prevent the bomb exploding.

pop.q: In the original 1991 Sega Megadrive game Sonic the Hedgehog, what items does Sonic collect to protect himself?
pop.why: Collecting golden rings prevents Sonic from losing a life whenever he bumps into enemies.

pop.q: Released in 1996, which electronic game instructed players to "Bop it", "Twist it", and which third action?
pop.why: The original 1996 electronic handheld game featured three main actions: Bop it, Twist it, and Pull it.

pop.q: Which wood care brand became famous in the 1990s for the tagline 'It does exactly what it says on the tin'?
pop.why: Ronseal introduced the iconic tagline in 1994, and it has since entered everyday British slang.

music.q: What was the title of The Stone Roses' long-awaited second studio album, released in December 1994?
music.why: Second Coming was released five years after their debut, peaking at number four in the UK album chart.

music.q: Which boy band achieved the UK Christmas Number 1 single in 1999 with 'I Have a Dream / Seasons in the Sun'?
music.why: Westlife's double A-side single kept Cliff Richard's 'The Millennium Prayer' off the top spot.

music.q: Which singer is the only person to have won the Eurovision Song Contest three times as a performer or songwriter?
music.why: Johnny Logan won twice as a singer in 1980 and 1987, and wrote Linda Martin's winning entry in 1992.

music.q: Which synth-pop duo, formed by Alison Moyet and Vince Clarke, released the hit 1982 album 'Upstairs at Eric's'?
music.why: Yazoo released 'Upstairs at Eric's' shortly after Vince Clarke departed Depeche Mode.

music.q: Which British band's 1997 music video for 'Bitter Sweet Symphony' features their lead singer walking down a London street?
music.why: The iconic music video for 'Bitter Sweet Symphony' was filmed along Hoxton Street in London.

mix.q: Which British rock group had a huge UK hit single in 1997 with the energetic track 'Tubthumping'?
mix.why: Chumbawamba reached number two in the UK and enjoyed massive international success with 'Tubthumping'.

mix.q: In the Channel 4 comedy series 'Spaced', what is the name of the eccentric artist who lives downstairs?
mix.why: Mark Heap played Brian Topp, the tortured conceptual artist living in the ground-floor flat.

mix.q: Which English county is home to the prehistoric stone circle at Avebury and the historic site of Stonehenge?
mix.why: Wiltshire contains both Stonehenge and Avebury, the world's largest prehistoric stone circle.

mix.q: In the 1999 psychological film 'Fight Club', what product do Tyler Durden and the Narrator manufacture and sell?
mix.why: They steal human fat from liposuction clinics to make high-end luxury soap.

mix.q: Which English synth-pop duo had a UK number one single in 1981 with their iconic cover of 'Tainted Love'?
mix.why: Marc Almond and Dave Ball formed Soft Cell, taking 'Tainted Love' to the top of the UK chart.

mix.q: What is the name of the hard, white outer layer that covers and protects the crown of a human tooth?
mix.why: Tooth enamel is the hardest substance in the human body.

mix.q: Which spirit is traditionally mixed with ginger beer and lime juice to create a Dark 'n' Stormy cocktail?
mix.why: A classic Dark 'n' Stormy is made with dark rum (traditionally Goslings) and ginger beer.

mix.q: Which 1997 Nintendo 64 racing game featured playable characters Diddy Kong, Banjo, and Conker the Squirrel?
mix.why: Diddy Kong Racing was a hugely popular N64 racer developed by Rare.

mix.q: Which British Prime Minister held up a piece of paper in 1938 and declared 'peace for our time'?
mix.why: Neville Chamberlain uttered the famous line upon returning from Munich in September 1938.

mix.q: Which American rock duo released the iconic guitar-riff single 'Seven Nation Army' in 2003?
mix.why: Jack and Meg White of The White Stripes released 'Seven Nation Army' on their album 'Elephant'.
